generated_for: Picnic Surf Shapes official named standup catalog
source: https://surfpicnic.com/pages/shapes (official Shopify shape pages — excludes apparel, hats, fins, wax, zines, bags, stickers, and shop merch)

brands.name: Picnic Surf Shapes
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped wooden and experimental Gulf Coast surf craft from Gregory Ruppe in Galveston, Texas.

models.name: Local Wizard
models.description: A take on refined 1966 involvement action, wide point center, low rocker, lifted rails with a rolled bottom into vee. For anywhere, anytime longboard surf year round 2-5' maximum fun.

models.name: Bäbi Log
models.description: Named after the late Milford Graves, and designed with flow and agility in mind. Single to double concave with a healthy amount of continuous rocker. Wide point set slightly back of center.

models.name: Altered Being
models.description: A modern noserider based on the work of a Gulf Coast legend. Moderate rocker, healthy concave in the nose, bellied bottom to double concave in the tail.

models.name: The Grackle
models.description: The Grackle is a transitional model that bridges the gap between longboard and short single fin, and will handle a wide range of surf. Modest displacement hull to vee bottom.

models.name: K.O.T.B.H
models.description: Liddle inspired. Wide point forward, s-decked, full outline, rolled bottom to vee. A good all-around hull with neutral handling.

models.name: K.O.T.B.H 2
models.description: Evolved from the K.O.T.B.H. Rolled bottom forward fading to flat in the tail. Single fin with a full outline. Good all-rounder that can handle more when it turns on.

models.name: Luna Bruja
models.description: A Mini Mal-inspired spell caster, simple and user-friendly, with natural rocker. 2-6ft waves.

models.name: Luna Brujita
models.description: A pared down version of the Luna Bruja. Increased speed and agility without sacrificing stability, loves a medium sized swell. Modern rails with subtle single concave entry to flat out the back. Works well as a single fin, 2+1, twin or quad.

models.name: Badtwin
models.description: Named after a past sound project and my take on the classic Simmons design. Full rails, low rocker, straight out the back. Fast and fun. Lots of room for variations here, from a traditional take on Simmons' keel design, to swallow tailed twin and quad set ups.

models.name: Beach Pigeon
models.description: Beach Pigeon, a Long Simmons version of the Bad Twin. Slight bellied bottom to channel. Fast and responsive, catches anything and everything.

models.name: Jazz Cabbage
models.description: A Gulf Coast collab shape, first developed between Pontcha Surf Club and Louisiana shaper Shane Madere, and handed over to me for further development. A little of the Beach Pigeon, and a little of the Astrohull, offering up a speedy twin that can handle better surf without sacrificing paddle power or stepping down to a fish.

models.name: Acid Dad
models.description: A retro fish outline and rocker template with a little more volume for the dads. Single to double concave out the back.
